summary: Aura Minerals Inc., a BVI-domiciled gold and base-metals miner listed on NASDAQ and B3, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 18, 2026, disclosing a US$200 million syndicated loan facility entered at the holding-company level. Citi and Itaú BBA served as joint lead arrangers and bookrunners. Pricing is SOFR plus 2.70% per annum, with a two-year grace period and five-year maturity; proceeds fund supplier payments and prepayment of production and selling costs. This is a routine credit facility, not a special situation.
